title: +*GENERAL CHEMISTRY I LABORATORY
description: Focuses on experiments that correspond to the topics covered in CH 221Z including the fundamentals of chemical measurements, quantitative relationships in chemical analysis, and understanding atomic and molecular structure. CH 221Z is a lecture course; CH 227Z is the laboratory component. (Core Education or Bacc Core Course if taken with CH 221Z)
attribute_description:
• Bacc Core, Perspectives - Physical Science (CPPS)
  • Core Education - Scientific Inquiry & Analysis Attached Lab (CFSL)
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
clssnotes:
Must be taken concurrently with CH 221Z. Course fee is non-refundable. Additional Supplies: https://beav.es/iAk Ecampus students not required to enroll in the lab
